title: Khon Kaen University's Thyroidectomy Registry
brief_summary: The endoscopic thyroidectomy approach is gaining popularity in the surgical field. This registry tries to collect the outcomes including quality of life and complication for both endoscopic and conventional thyroidectomy methods.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* The patients who underwent thyroidectomy at Khon Kaen University

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
study_population: The patients who underwent thyroidectomy at Khon Kaen University
